mechanic.1: Tap a mirror to turn it 90°. Guide the light to the target!
mechanic.2: There are several mirrors. Plan the beam's path from the start.
mechanic.3: Walls stop the light. Mirrors with a dark frame are fixed and don't turn.
mechanic.4: Colored sources! Each target wants light in the color of its ring. Red + green = yellow.
mechanic.5: Color filters only let their own color through. White light comes out of a filter colored.
mechanic.6: A prism splits light. Relative to the beam's DIRECTION OF TRAVEL, red turns left, green goes straight and blue turns right: on a beam going down, red ends up on the right of the screen.
mechanic.7: There are several targets. They all have to light up at the same time to finish the level.
mechanic.8: Gold blocks stop the light. Drag one to slide it by one square.
mechanic.9: When the light hits a key, the door of the same color opens.
mechanic.10: All the mechanics together. Show that you're a true Light Master!
